sections_target.text: Testing the IO-C-B1 overcurrent protection device

rows: Insert the test socket into its designated place in the relay.
Connect the current injection leads between the injection test set and the test socket as follows: (R-1, N-2).
Connect the timer leads to points (8, 7) on the test socket.
Switch the injection test set On, raise the current gradually and record the pick-up value of the device (start of movement of the device disc).
Reduce the injection current gradually until the device disc moves in the reverse direction, and record the reset value.

To calculate the time recording of the device, do the following: raise the current to the preset setting value on the relay (as per the previous connection); switch the injection test set Off; set the timer and reset it (as per the previous connection); switch the injection test set On and note the start of the timer; the injection test set will switch off automatically when the timer stops; record the time delay.
Repeat the previous steps (1-7) to test the electrical protection devices installed on phases S and T, and record the results.

sections_target.text: Testing the IO-C1-B1 overcurrent protection device

rows: Move the test socket to the device installed on phase R, model (IO-C1-B1).
Add a short circuit between points (9-12) and (10-11) on the test socket.
Follow the same previous steps (1 to 7) to test the overcurrent protection element of the device.
To test the short-circuit current protection element of the device, raise the current to the preset setting value using the same connection points, and record and note the PICK-UP and RESET values.

sections_target.text: Testing the earth leakage protection device (IO-L-B1)

rows: Follow the same previous steps (1 to 7) after moving the test socket to the earth leakage protection device, model IO-L-B1, removing the short circuit between (9-12, 10-11) on the test socket, noting that for step 7 the current is raised to the preset setting value on the relay (SETTING).
Record the pick-up, reset and time delay values.
Record the above results on the Test Sheet, sign it and write the test date.

Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the overcurrent protection devices mentioned above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Gehan Abdel Monsef, and the field test was carried out by Eng. Mokhles Mahmoud Refaei. It was approved by Eng. Mahmoud Saad Balbaa, Sector Head, and reviewed and documented by Eng. Mona El-Sharkawy, Senior Engineering Consultant and Coordinator of the Maintenance Procedures Information System at the West Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Ensure that the circuit breaker of the bay on which the protection device mentioned is installed is open.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.

Procedures to be Carried Out
Testing the IO-C-B1 overcurrent protection device
Insert the test socket into its designated place in the relay. | 1.
Short-circuit points (7-14, 8-13) on the socket. | 2.
Connect the current injection leads between the injection test set and the test socket as follows: (R-1, N-2). | 3.
Connect the timer leads to points (8, 7) on the test socket. | 4.
Switch the injection test set On, raise the current gradually and record the pick-up value of the device (start of movement of the device disc). | 5.
Reduce the injection current gradually until the device disc moves in the reverse direction, and record the reset value. | 6.
To calculate the time recording of the device, do the following: raise the current to the preset setting value on the relay (as per the previous connection); switch the injection test set Off; set the timer and reset it (as per the previous connection); switch the injection test set On and note the start of the timer; the injection test set will switch off automatically when the timer stops; record the time delay. | 7.
Repeat the previous steps (1-7) to test the electrical protection devices installed on phases S and T, and record the results. | 8.
Testing the IO-C1-B1 overcurrent protection device
Move the test socket to the device installed on phase R, model (IO-C1-B1). | 1.
Add a short circuit between points (9-12) and (10-11) on the test socket. | 2.
Follow the same previous steps (1 to 7) to test the overcurrent protection element of the device. | 3.
To test the short-circuit current protection element of the device, raise the current to the preset setting value using the same connection points, and record and note the PICK-UP and RESET values. | 4.
Testing the earth leakage protection device (IO-L-B1)
Follow the same previous steps (1 to 7) after moving the test socket to the earth leakage protection device, model IO-L-B1, removing the short circuit between (9-12, 10-11) on the test socket, noting that for step 7 the current is raised to the preset setting value on the relay (SETTING). | 1.
Record the pick-up, reset and time delay values. | 2.
Record the above results on the Test Sheet, sign it and write the test date. | 3.
